notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.52.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Sua loi khung hang giua "khong join vao nen": chan khung chi cham mat nen nen Join Geometry khong co tac dung, tren mat bang khung hang giua hien ca keo nhin tu tren xuong thay vi bi cat nhu cot hang bien. - Khi dung nha xe, chan khung nay duoc ha 2 mm vao nen va nen cat chan khung: moi cot deu hien kieu bi cat tren mat bang. - Nha xe da dung bang ban cu: dung lai (hoac ha khung 2 mm, Join Geometry roi Switch Join Order de nen cat khung).
